notes.title: Apology and price reduction
notes.content:
It seems that the following problem may occur with some personal computers.
As for the following defect, it seems to be a defect of the entire shooting controller, so there is no prospect of correcting it.
As an apology, we will reduce the price of the game.
We will do our best to prevent this from happening from the next game.

About the defect.
After saving and exiting the game, you may not be able to fire bullets when you start and load the game again.

Methods that may be solved.
Restart the game.
Completing a game without Save and Load.
Wait a few minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39281401/1b917086893deddd6374350e1e3fcb0a836c39b3.png[/img]

notes.title: Trivia
notes.content:
Let's go to a place with a stone statue!
Her facial expression changes depending on the situation.
A green jewel is really exist. Let's turn around once in a while and look up!
She's wearing a ring on her right hand.
Her walking animation is different outside and inside the dungeon.

Currently up to version 1.05, 5 updates have been made.
Don't forget to play a free DLC game!
An internal meeting will decide whether to further develop more DLCs.
Thank you for playing!

notes.title: List of bug fixes
notes.content:
Version 1.01
Bug: When Poco is unarmed.
When she takes down the enemy, he comes alive like zombies.
Solution: Removed the Take-Down. (when she is unarmed.)

Version 1.02
Fixed the phenomenon that the animation becomes strange when the player enters the water after flying while armed.

Version 1.03
Made minor corrections.

Version 1.04 
Dealt with a phenomenon in which the motion becomes strange when entering flight mode while aiming. The music on the loading screen is too noisy, so we deleted it.

Version 1.05
After removing the take-down(unarmed), we dealt with the problem that the enemy becomes a zombie in the armed take-down.
Supported Traditional Chinese.

To play a previous versions
Right-click the game name in the STEAM Library.
Properties.
Betas.
